messages:
ella: Heads-up — we need a late-night cohort egress swap + BMC nic micro-reboot across APAC edge (az13/az14/az15) tonight 02:00–03:30 UTC. Plan: stagger 5 nodes/cycle, cordon -> drain -> reboot BMC -> uncordon. Expect transient NIC flaps during PSU handoff. @infra-oncall can you run the canary at 01:45? :wave:
mike: Which pools are affected? any impact to Dedicated?
ella: Dedicated/reserved capacity should be isolated (no reprovisioning). Hosted saturn-pool and burst paths will see p99 token latency blips and a few short job restarts. We'll route new allocations to eu-burst for the window.
infra-oncall: I can do 01:45 canary. Will follow the 5-node cohort playbook and post deploy-bot updates.
dinesh: Cost question — backfilling to eu-burst: are we using preemptible GPUs or on-demand? need estimate for tonight (2x cycles).
ella: Proposal: use preemptible where tenant allows (non-SLA), on-demand for critical tenants only. Rough estimate: ~12 GPU-hours on on-demand, ~48 GPU-hours preemptible worst-case.
lisa: For product tenants with reserved capacity, we must avoid preemptible fallback. I'll DM list of critical tenants now.
mike: Can we reduce backfill by lowering batch sizes / pausing background eval jobs for the window?
dinesh: Yes, pausing evals would save ~30% of the peak surge. Recommend runbook step to throttle evals 01:55–03:40 UTC.
ella: Good call. I'll add throttle to the playbook and update the maintenance page.
infra-oncall: Canary checklist: 1) cordon cohort-1 (5 nodes) 2) drain with --ignore-daemonsets + notify deploy-bot 3) BMC soft-reboot 4) run net-check (iperf) 5) uncordon. If net-check fails, rollback to next cohort and escalate.
ella: Inline snippet for drain command we'll use (short):
```
kubectl cordon node-abc-123
kubectl drain node-abc-123 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=20m
```
infra-oncall: ACK. Will add to the automated workflow.
deploy-bot: Maintenance window created: 6839991111 | 02:00–03:30 UTC | APAC edge cohort (az13-15). Canary scheduled 01:45 UTC.
lisa: Also notify support and status page 90m before start. I'll open a short customer comms draft.
dinesh: Re: billing — I'll budget the expected 12 on-demand GPU-hours to infra-ops cost center (cc:cost-team). If preemptible usage spikes, we cap at 60 GPU-hours.
mike: Postmortem action: add telemetry to detect NIC-flap correlated with PSU handoff within 10s window.
ella: Agree. Runbook updated; will post final slack ping 90m and 15m before start. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
